$comment: Project-defined draft (weekly_update_schema_version 0.1.0) of the SAFE-Starter-Kit weekly machine-readable update. This is NOT an official SAFE schema: SAFE v1.0 adopts no weekly update schema. Fields and enums are provisional until the F0 decision log is signed off.
title: SAFE-Starter-Kit weekly machine-readable update (draft 0.1.0)
description: Internal weekly status record for a case that has at least one open significant risk. It needs no approval and is sent to no external recipient. It holds no free text: impact scope text, deadline reasons and other notes stay in the case. Timestamps are UTC (RFC 3339 with Z).

weekly_update_schema_version.description: Version of this schema. Changes to the fields or enums change it.

weekly_update_id.description: Stable ID of this update. It does not change when the update is read again.

case_reference.description: The human-readable case reference, as shown in the case list.

sequence.description: 1 for the first update of the case, then 2, 3 and so on. Numbers are never reused.

generated_at.description: When the update was generated, in UTC.

next_update_due_at.description: When the next update is due: 7 elapsed days after generated_at, while the risk is still open.

significant_risks.description: The impact areas of the case whose severity is high or critical at generation. An update exists only while at least one is listed.

deadline_tasks.description: The five SAFE deadline tasks of the case at generation, in due-date order. Legal duties are separate records and are not listed.
